facts.fact: The deal record states that IDA lent Côte d'Ivoire 84,356,070,200 FCFA (US$150 million equivalent) under an agreement concluded on 17 October 2025 for phase 1 of PADCI / RAPID-CI, of which US$45 million is allocated to broadband for targeted public institutions, town halls and sub-prefectures being in the connectivity component's scope.

The deal record gives the implementing agency of PADCI / RAPID-CI phase 1 as the Ministry of Digital Transition and Digitalization, with the Republic of Côte d'Ivoire as borrower under the agreement of 17 October 2025.

The deal record states that PADCI / RAPID-CI phase 1 runs from 2025 to 2030 with a costed component of US$45 million for broadband to targeted public institutions, its connectivity scoped to schools, health centres, social centres, town halls, sub-prefectures, courts, post offices and regional directorates, and fenced to Abidjan, Yamoussoukro and twelve regions.

The loan agreement for PADCI / RAPID-CI phase 1, whose connectivity component covers town halls among other public facilities, was concluded between IDA and Côte d'Ivoire on 17 October 2025 and ratified by decree on 4 February 2026; the record states financing, not any connection made.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transition and Digitalization, financed by an IDA credit
systems.tiers: Planned: public facilities including town halls and sub-prefectures, in Abidjan, Yamoussoukro and twelve regions; no count of town halls given
